title: Sadak Jaɓaaɗo e Yurmeende
intro: Uddit gite maa, ƴeewto-ɗaa falnde mawnde, deƴƴunde ɗo iimanaagal jarribee haa keerol mum. Aɗa jogori hawrude e limre nde ɗooftaare mum deeƴnde e yeeso yamiroore nde miijaaka, wayli sahaa jarribo, wonti maande duumiinde ɗooftaare e yurmeende Alla.
clues: Miɗo siftoree e nder Quraan e nder muñɓe e muñal tiiɗngal.
Miɗo wonnoo e hakkunde njillu jarriborgu ɗooftaare yamiroore Alla.
Nde kaaldaa e gite ɗee, mbi’mi waɗ no yamiraa nii, aɗa tawa mi e nder muñɓe.
Mi lelnaama e sadak, kono Alla noddii wonde yi’annde ndee timmii.
Alla soodi mi e sadak mawɗo, acciri mi teddungal e nder yontaaji garooji.
Miin woni Ismaa’il, mo Ibraahiima umminii tuugnorgal suudu cemmbinndu, ciftoraaɗo e bannge Idris e Dhul-Kifl e nder moƴƴuɓe.

trial.label: Ñaawoore/Kewu
options: Noddude maayɓe e nguurndam e dow yamiroore Alla
Yeddude peeje e balans e nder njulaagu

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Fiyaaɗo e ɓuuɓri mawndi ngam salaade gelooɗi debbo
Mantaaɗo e nder annabaaɓe muñɓe e peewɓe
Njokkii e maayo ina rewa gooŋɗinɓe
outcome.answer: Mantaaɗo e nder annabaaɓe muñɓe e peewɓe

arabic: وَأَدْخَلْنَـٰهُمْ فِى رَحْمَتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّهُم مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verse: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous. (21:86)
